heading: Paying for your session
intro: Payment is due before your session. Any of the three below is fine — use whichever you already have. Please include your name in the note so I can match it to your appointment.

methods.name: Venmo
methods.note: Include your name in the payment note.

methods.name: PayPal
methods.note: Please send as 'Friends and Family' if you are able.

methods.name: Zelle
methods.note: Send through your own bank's app using the email or phone number above.

footnote: If cost is the only thing standing between you and getting help, say so on the contact page. We will work something out.
supportBody: The prayers, videos, and the Sunshine page stay free for everyone, always. If you would like to help keep them that way, a gift through any of the methods above — marked 'gift' — goes directly toward that.
